The purple hair strands exhibit slight clumping and a 'painted' texture rather than distinct individual fibers, which is common in AI-generated hair but less severe than full melting.
The scissors appear slightly warped and lack sharp geometric definition, blending softly into the background, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field blur.
